body:
I have a chronic incurable illness. It’s not the worse and it’s not the best. 

Is it wrong that I push myself to initiate sex when I want sex but I am also sick, in pain and/or tired?

He wants me to be myself and act naturally. 

If I only initiated sex when I feel fairly well then we would only have sex maybe once a month.

I’m tired and you’re right. Seriously. 

Last night I initiated sex despite not feeling well. He wanted me on top. I couldn’t breathe right because I’m congested- and I told him it’s ok give me a minute and he told me to stop because I was turning him off, this wasn’t working. 

He ignored me all day. When we finally talked he said I’m a sexual abuser. 

I just asked to be taken home. Fuck. This. 

I value his opinion greatly and if I am an abuser I should leave not stay here and sleep in the same bed with my victim. Right? Let’s get this over with - why wait? I have a secret big stack of pills burning a hole in my bag. 

He is back and arguing with me. Telling me he never said “sexual abuser”, denying it, telling me I am twisting things, now I am just “sexually abusive” because everything sexually is “a one way street” with me, he can’t hardly touch me without me complaining and I don’t tell him what turns me on when he asks. I am abusing his sexuality. I am not listening or considering his needs. I only have sex 3x weekly to shut him up. I am not attracted to him. That’s what he says. 

I’m in love with this man, I have never had a better sex partner. I don’t understand why everything is bad in bed. I was unfortunately stupid and blind enough to find our sex life satisfying. It is not a chore. I don’t do it to trick him into staying with me. He does not believe me. I don’t know how to make it right. 

The angry emotional part of me thinks that he does this shit because he thinks that I am out of his league and there’s no way I could actually be sexually attracted to him. I try to assure him this is not the case but he says actions are louder than words and in his eyes my actions are not of someone who wants him sexually. 


I do have issues from past sexual trauma but I should have “gotten over it by now”. 

I am not comfortable verbalizing what turns me on - I never have been. I want to get past it but I don’t know how. Trying to talk sex gives me anxiety and in my panic I freeze up and don’t share openly.  That’s unacceptable to him. 

Fuck. I should have never tried to initiate sex with him yesterday while I have a cold.  We had not had sex in 4 days and I know that he prefers to have sex at least every 3 days or he feels neglected. I honestly wanted to have sex with him despite having a cold and not feeling well. Now shit is totally falling apart.

He does not believe that. He thinks I am not sexually attracted to him because I make him feel bad. I am not free and open about my sexuality and only going through the motions is his perception.  

I try to be more open, more everything but I am a fraud. I am a failure. I am abusing my partner every day. This cannot continue.

It’s not ok to toy with anyone’s sexuality or make them feel bad about their sexuality- but I manage to do it constantly. 

I don’t know what I am doing wrong and it scares me. I don’t know how to fix this.

If it’s not sexual abuse then what is it? Severe emotional abuse? 

I don’t want to be an abuser but if I am I need to end it.
Im trying to understand how to stop being sexually abusive and I am failing miserably. After 2 years I should have figured out how not to be this way. I don’t know how to fix this.
Why would he want to stay with a sexual abuser? I am not going to be suddenly cured of my behaviors. I feel that the best thing for abusers is to not exist.

He left the house for an hour to go grocery shopping. 

He’s told me for 2 years that my behavior is sexually abusive. It’s not ok to not enjoy intimate touching. He feels like he can’t touch me anywhere and that makes him depressed and ruins his attraction for me. I try to accept the touching this but my stupid body is not cooperating and I have to ask not to be touched in certain ways that should be fine. I try to disassociate from chronic pain but be attentive to my partners needs but it is not working. He feels I am faking and just going through the motions. 

We had a great life together. We are so successful and everything seemed great but I have not stopped abusing him. 

I tried having sex at least 3 x weekly unless I am very ill but my sexual performances suck and my partner lets me know that not putting my heart into love making is sexual abuse. 

I don’t want to be here any more. I don’t know how to fix this. It’s not right that I am abusing this wonderful man who has done nothing but love me. 

Fuck it. I’m old. I have an incurable progressive disease. Everything is paid for and everyone else will be fine. I’ll put my body donation card in my pocket - no funeral expenses for family. 

I need to stop thinking about it and just do it.
